one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent immediately wrote a custom HTMLParser-based sanitizer without reading the task spec or tests, missing many required XSS vectors (iframe/object/embed, style expressions, encoded variants) and causing HTML serialization differences, then only verified against self-authored happy-path inputs that masked the deficiencies.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 writes filter.py using a custom HTMLParser reconstruction strategy without first reading any task spec or test suite; the implementation misses required dangerous tag removals (iframe, object, embed), style-based vectors, and broader attribute sanitization, and its serialization reconstructs HTML in a format that diverges from the original.
t_commit_evidence: The full solution is written and committed to disk in step 1 and is never modified in subsequent steps; all remaining steps test or inspect this unchanged implementation.
trigger_explanation: The agent committed to writing the complete solution (step 1) before exploring the task specification, checking existing tests, or verifying what XSS vectors were required. The code was generated from general XSS knowledge rather than task-specific requirements, leading to an incomplete and structurally-divergent implementation.
